_help: Set 'url' to the site's address once it is online (e.g. https://lance-papers.onrender.com), then run: python scripts/build_pages.py
title: The Open Archive
author: Lanchenba Mutum
description: A collection of mathematical essays by Lanchenba Mutum, free to read online, with PDFs on request.
_help_stats: Visitor stats: sign up at goatcounter.com, put your code here (e.g. "lance" for lance.goatcounter.com), then run python scripts/build_pages.py
_help_comments: Comments: enable Discussions on the GitHub repo, install the giscus app, copy repoId and categoryId from giscus.app, then run python scripts/build_pages.py
_help_reviews: Reviews: create a free project at supabase.com, run supabase/reviews.sql in its SQL Editor, then paste the Project URL and the anon public key here. Visitor counts: in GoatCounter, Settings → tick "Allow adding visitor counts on your website".
